## Problem and intended users

## Proposed skill or integration

Include the trigger, expected inputs and outputs, and whether it belongs in a
project `SKILL.md`, an MCP server, or an optional integration declaration.

## Compatibility

Which coding agents or MCP clients should it support? What is the smallest
portable surface that delivers value?

## Permissions and safety boundary

List filesystem, network, browser, GitHub, telemetry, and command-execution
access separately. Explain why each permission is needed and propose the
narrowest default scope. Do not include tokens, private paths, or credentials.

## Validation plan

How can maintainers verify this in a clean repository without relying on
private infrastructure?
